evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Across four frontier, mid-tier, and open-weight models on MATH-500, ALFWorld, and SpreadsheetBench, EfficientSkill cuts output tokens over unconstrained EvoSkill on 11 of 12 configurations (by up to 80%) while raising mean accuracy on every benchmark, including +14.3 and +17.5 percentage-point gains on SpreadsheetBench with Gemini 3.8 Flash and Grok 4.1 Fast by replacing stalled loops with compact workflows.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We introduce EfficientSkill, a two-step framework that first discovers a reliable skill without token penalties, and then warm-starts accuracy-guarded pruning from that skill to compress instructions, bound agent turns, and offload reusable code into workspace utilities with zero implementation prompt cost.
